audit.title: Change log
audit.description: Who changed what in this workspace: you, your team, AI, Danil support or the system. Only what changed is kept, never the content.
audit.filter: Filter by who made the change
audit.filter_partial: The filter only checks the loaded changes. Load earlier ones to see more.
audit.empty: No changes have been logged in this workspace yet.
audit.empty_filter: No changes of this kind among the loaded ones.
audit.no_account: Your session has no active Danil workspace. Choose one and open this section again.
audit.forbidden: Only workspace admins can see the change log.
audit.unavailable: The change log could not be read. Check the connection and try again.
